_what: The headline claims control/run.mjs holds README.md and results.md to. Each entry names, per file ('in'), the exact sentence fragment that states it, so a number changed inside that sentence is an integrity violation (exit 4). "times" (per file) is how often the sentence stands there, so one edited copy among several fails. An entry with a 'folder' is a checker hash computed live by folderSha256 (control/lib.mjs): with a 'text', the folder must still hash to it; without one, the live hash is required; '{}' in a fragment stands for that hash. 'numberLines' holds, per doc, the SHA-256 of every line with a digit in it, so a number changed anywhere in that doc fails; a claim may also name a session file, so the sentence a doc quotes from it cannot be deleted.
